text_block_list.text: One day, at a research seminar—

text_block_list.name: ST-2 & Taishin
text_block_list.text: Haaaaaaaaahhh!!

text_block_list.name: ST-2 (Satie)
text_block_list.text:
Mmh, that's strange... Why is this happening...?
I feel like the link got cut off again...

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Yeah. When her stride is on point, she's really fast.
"Running purely on instinct, ST-2 can now run subconsciously. Her explosive power has increased, but... the connection inevitably gets cut off at times."

Upon entering a state of deep focus, she cannot sustain the sense of oneness.
The cause is...
choice_data_list: Air Shakur, could you wash it again for me?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: The data? Hold on a sec.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: There really are moments when a disconnect occurs between the Doctor's consciousness and the ST-2 body.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
"And until it reconnects, there's a time lag.
That's what's dragging me down."

text_block_list.name: Sugar Lights
text_block_list.text: I see. Is the reason... because I'm still inexperienced?

text_block_list.name: Sugar Lights
text_block_list.text:
"To be honest, I feel like I've gotten close to how I was during my prime.
However..."

text_block_list.name: Sugar Lights
text_block_list.text:
Perhaps her senses haven't fully returned yet.
That's why she can't properly handle
the ST-2's capabilities...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Maybe. But we won't know for sure
until we investigate further.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Still, getting the Professor involved in the deciphering
might drain the stamina she needs for running...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
As for anyone else who might be useful...
Maybe this one?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, lend me a hand.
If we combine my data with your expertise,
we might be able to figure something out.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
The keyword is "unconscious."
The Professor can already control the ST-2 unconsciously.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Yet for some reason, there are moments when that subconscious connection cuts out. An error occurs, and it gets severed.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Why does the deviation occur?
If I can just figure that out—the problem will be solved.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Give me every possible hypothesis you can think of.
To sift through data, I need hypotheses first and foremost.

What in the world is going on? Even without computer knowledge,
I should at least be able to think through that much.
choice_data_list: So Dr. Lights will let her guard down, or something?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Well, my concentration won't hold out forever.
Still, that's out of the question.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: "She's not running for that long at a time, and besides, the Doctor's ability to maintain focus is really something else."
choice_data_list: Is it because ST-2's specs are too high?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: That seemed like the most likely possibility, but apparently not. In fact—

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: The mental fatigue the Doctor experienced before our training run the other day doesn't show up in the data at all.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Everything's accounted for. Clearly sufficient.
And yet, if it's still not working out—

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: What... is the cause?

—I think. I mustn't get caught up in the fine details.
I can just leave the details to Air Shakur.

Everything is sufficient.
If things still aren't going well despite that—
choice_data_list: Could it actually be... over the limit?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: “—What? Overcoat?”
choice_data_list: Yeah, if it's not lacking... then is it too much?
Yeah, if it's not a shortage... is it an excess?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Don't talk crazy. Something like that...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
No, but still...
It couldn't be...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
—Alright, I understand.
In that case...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: —Get out.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, get out. You're in the way of my review.
From here on, this is my room.

With no other option, I gave up the Trainer's Office.
The situation was urgent.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
"While running, the Doctor remains completely focused.
And her legs move entirely on instinct."

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: "Still, the kind of legs the Doctor envisions are—"

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: It's "my legs back when I could walk normally."

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
The same principle as phantom pain.
The Doctor can still feel her legs from back then even now.
However—

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: What if her legs in the past and her legs now... were different—?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
If the Professor's current image of them
has already surpassed her old legs—

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
...Found it. This is it.
This misalignment.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
List all of this out and calculate it down to the finest numbers.
If I do that—
And the next day—

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Looks like everyone's here.
Alright. Then let's...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Make fine adjustments to eliminate the awkwardness of ST-2.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: Hmm... Can you do it?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, Trainer was the one who found the clue,
for the most part.
choice_data_list: (Though after finding it... they kicked me out.)
(Though after finding it... I got kicked out.)

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: The answer is—right here.

text_block_list.name: Sugar Lights
text_block_list.text: Air Shakur, what should I do?

text_block_list.name: Sugar Lights
text_block_list.text:
Should I downgrade after all?
If I adjust it lower where I can't keep up with ST-2...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
No, the solution is
to set the ST-2 adjustment level to...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
"If anything, raise it.
Doctor, you are underestimating yourself."

text_block_list.name: Sugar Lights
text_block_list.text: What, raising it, you say!?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. You base your ideals on
back when you were healthy and uninjured.
And...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: The ST-2 is also configured that way. That's what caused the trouble.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
You've already surpassed your active racing days.
At least in spirit, that is.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
ST-2 can reach it now.
The domain that the old you could never reach.
That is why...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Take off the limiter. You've still got plenty in reserve.
Release just as much of it as I tell you to.

text_block_list.name: Sugar Lights
text_block_list.text:
Release the limiter...
—Alright, understood.

text_block_list.name: ST-2 & Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Haaaaaaaah!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Incredible...! What a display...!
To run alongside me and keep up until the very end...

text_block_list.name: ST-2 (Satie)
text_block_list.text:
The link wasn't just breaking... on the contrary, the boundary between consciousness and body vanished...
Completely...

text_block_list.name: ST-2 (Satie)
text_block_list.text:
I was always... ST-2.
And ST-2 is me...

text_block_list.name: ST-2 (Satie)
text_block_list.text: Air Shakur...!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Naturally. The numbers turned out just like I said, right?
If it grows, we can just fine-tune accordingly.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
"Listen closely.
From now on, do not overestimate or underestimate yourself."

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: When it comes to numbers—exact is always best.

text_block_list.name: ST-2 (Satie)
text_block_list.text: Ah, thank you, Air Shakur!

The unexpected cause of the trouble was Dr. Wright's growth spurt.
Air Shakur saw right through it and resolved the issue masterfully.
